subject.title: feishu_doc `create` action silently ignores `content` parameter — creates empty document

question: Should `feishu_doc` support one-call create-with-content, or should create-time content be rejected and documented as a two-step create/write workflow?
rationale: Both choices fix the silent drop, but they define different Feishu tool semantics and recovery expectations after a partial create/write failure.

options.title: Support create with content
options.body: Land the create-then-write path only with schema coverage, focused tests, and a response/error shape that preserves created document identity when possible.

options.title: Reject content on create
options.body: Keep create as title-only and make supplied content fail fast with docs/skill text pointing agents to the explicit write action.

recommendation.title: Support create with content
recommendation.body: Land the create-then-write path only with schema coverage, focused tests, and a response/error shape that preserves created document identity when possible.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin is documented as community maintained by @m1heng, and this is a Feishu tool contract choice.
